immutable_selection_rules.repo_local: bind results to the repository base revision and tree
immutable_selection_rules.mathlib: use only the lake-manifest pin and its clean checked-out tree; historical objects must be ancestors of the pin
immutable_selection_rules.external: resolve moving refs to a full commit before classification and bind inspected source/toolchain/manifest/license files to SHA-256
immutable_selection_rules.negative_search: bind dated API responses or explicit access failures to SHA-256; bounded no-match evidence never proves global absence

credential_policy: Use anonymous public read APIs only. Do not expose credentials, clone or fetch dependencies, change Lake inputs, or mutate Formalizations/Lean/.lake. Record HTTP 403/429 and timeouts rather than bypassing them.
network_policy: Network is permitted only for read-only discovery metadata and immutable raw/archive inspection. Candidate elaboration uses the existing local pinned toolchain without dependency mutation.
candidate_fields_required: project, canonical remote, immutable revision and tree when available
module, file, source hash, declaration, and exact type

status_boundary: This protocol freezes a bounded discovery run. Classification of all recorded candidates does not imply exhaustive global discovery, accepted machine closure, audit completion, or theorem completion.
